title: Vikram and Betal: The Lost Horse

scenes.summary: Betal tells a story about a lost horse.
scenes.text: Betal told Vikram about a man who lost his horse.
scenes.image_prompt: vikram carrying betal in forest cartoon style

scenes.text: The man searched for his missing horse but failed.
scenes.image_prompt: man looking for horse worried cartoon

scenes.text: The wise man gathered all villagers to find the thief.
scenes.image_prompt: villagers gathered in front of wise man cartoon

scenes.text: The guilty man became nervous during the test.
The wise man caught the thief. Vikram answered wisely, and Betal flew away.

story: A man lost his horse. A wise man used fear to identify the thief. Vikram said fear reveals the truth.
